stories.title: Define Sponsor Display Schema Contract
stories.description: Define frontend data contract for sponsor credibility including sponsor name, type, funding source (public/private/undisclosed), collaborators, and score contribution. Ensure compatibility with backend feature EVAL-CT-MEASURE-SPONSOR.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx — rendering pipeline requires structured payload for display.

stories.title: Implement Sponsor Credibility Rendering Logic
stories.description: Implement logic to parse sponsor data and compute display-ready fields (e.g., normalized funding labels, collaborator formatting, score contribution text) for use in UI components.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx — existing message rendering requires transformation layer before display.

stories.title: Build Sponsor Credibility UI Component
stories.description: Create UI component within MessageBubble rendering flow to display sponsor credibility block in trial scorecard, including sponsor name, type, funding source, collaborators, and contribution to score.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx — primary UI surface for structured clinical trial outputs.

stories.title: Integrate Sponsor Data into API Response Handling
stories.description: Extend frontend API response handling to accept and pass through sponsor credibility data from backend into rendering pipeline without breaking existing trial display flows.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/App.tsx and MessageBubble.tsx — API response ingestion and rendering pipeline integration.

stories.title: Add Unit and UI Tests for Sponsor Display
stories.description: Create unit tests for sponsor data transformation logic and UI tests validating correct rendering of sponsor credibility fields including edge cases (missing funding source, multiple collaborators).
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx — component behavior requires validation; existing test patterns in frontend and backend tests directories.
